max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.

steps.message: The 60 limit came from the Northwind contract, which ended on 2025-10-31. Our own warehouse has no line limit, and the config and design doc already say 100. So the ADR is the stale one.

arguments.command:
cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md]
---
The config (config/cart.yaml) and design doc (docs/design/cart.md) say 100; ADR 0007 says 60. The 60 came from section 4 of the Northwind Logistics contract (max 60 lines per order, one cart = one order). That contract ended 2025-10-31 and fulfilment moved to our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md), so the reason for 60 no longer exists. Support data shows 40 inquiries with requests up to 100, so 100 is adopted and ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md'
s=open(p).read().replace("Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)","Status: Superseded by docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md (limit is now 100; the Northwind contract ended 2025-10-31)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

steps.message:
The cart limit is 100. I haven't committed anything or touched issue #12.

- **Why 100:** The old limit of 60 came from section 4 of the Northwind Logistics contract, which allowed at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31. Fulfilment now runs from our own warehouse, which has no line limit. Support also logged 40 inquiries from customers asking for carts of up to 100.
- **Config and design doc:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so I left them alone.
- **ADR 0007:** It still said 60, so I changed its status line in `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` to "Superseded" and pointed it at the new record.
- **Decision record:** `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md` records the decision as 100, with the files that decided it and the reasoning.
